whenToUse: Small icon-only buttons, such as close or more.
Pressing a whole list row opens it.
whenNotToUse: Touch areas are so dense they overlap (make room first).
A single press would cause an irreversible result (add a confirmation step).
Actions visible only on mouse hover.
